tagline: Detect Earlier. Respond Smarter. Protect the City.
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO / COMMAND CENTER FUTURISM

design_philosophy.core_concept: High-density Tactical Command Center UI for urban public health & emergency response intelligence.
anti_patterns: NO standard light/white generic medical site look
NO rounded soft friendly consumer app aesthetic
NO transparent backgrounds on dropdowns, modals or sticky overlays without proper backdrop blur and solid tint
NO center-aligned text blocks for telemetry or metrics
NO generic placeholder icons or missing test IDs
key_principles: Tactical Dark Aesthetics: Deep slate/obsidian (#07090E) with precise hairline grid borders (#1E293B)
Strict Semantic Risk Palette: LOW=Emerald (#10B981), MODERATE=Amber (#F59E0B), HIGH=Rose/Red (#EF4444)
Information Density & Modular Bento Grid: Monospaced numeric readouts, micro sparklines, real-time pulse dots
Explainability First: AI flags must feature transparent attribution factors and confidence metrics
Dynamic Spatial Map Integration: Dark-themed Leaflet canvas with custom polygon zones and pulse markers

typography.mono_font: JetBrains Mono, Source Code Pro, monospace

scale.h3: text-lg font-semibold tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-300 font-mono
scale.caption: text-xs font-mono text-slate-400 uppercase tracking-wider

visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl bg-slate-900/80 border border-slate-800/80 shadow-2xl shadow-black/50

key_components_to_build.kpi_cards: 4 metric blocks: Citywide Risk Score (e.g., 78/100 HIGH), Active Anomaly Signals (3 Active), Hospital ICU Capacity (84.2% Occupied), Emergency Fleet Response ETA (6.4 min avg).
key_components_to_build.leaflet_map: Leaflet Map centered on city, with 6 geojson/polygon zones color-filled according to risk state (green/orange/red), interactive popups on hover/click, hospital markers, ambulance moving units with radar pulse.
key_components_to_build.simulation_controller: Primary button 'SIMULATE INCOMING DATA' trigger with loading state 'Analyzing incoming signals...' that updates zone risk states, charts, and alert cards; and 'RESET SIMULATION' button.
key_components_to_build.alert_card: ABNORMAL HEALTH PATTERN DETECTED highlight banner featuring Zone 4, risk severity level HIGH, key triggers, time detected, and quick action trigger button.
key_components_to_build.explainability_panel: WHY WAS ZONE 4 FLAGGED? panel containing SHAP-style feature importance bars (ER ILI Admissions 42%, Wastewater SARS-CoV-2/Flu-A ratio 28%, School Absences 18%, OTC Antipyretic Sales 12%), model confidence 92.4%.
key_components_to_build.spatial_cluster_panel: Geospatial dispersion analysis card displaying spillover risk percentages to neighboring Zone 3 and Zone 5.
key_components_to_build.hospital_network_cards: Cards showing 3 major city hospitals (e.g. St. Jude General, City Memorial, Valley Health) with live ICU bed counts, ER wait times, ventilator availability, and triage redirect status.
key_components_to_build.ambulance_intelligence: Telemetry feed for 4 mobile units (MED-101, MED-104, MED-202, MED-309) showing location, patient triage score, destination hospital, dynamic reroute suggestion.
key_components_to_build.response_plan_panel: Automated AI containment playbook with interactive checkboxes, action execution buttons ('Trigger Level-2 Triage', 'Notify CDC Portal', 'Deploy Mobile Diagnostic Van').
key_components_to_build.recharts_analytics: 3 interactive Recharts components: 1. 24-Hour ER Admissions vs Model Prediction (AreaChart), 2. Wastewater Viral Concentration Trajectory across 6 Zones (LineChart), 3. Syndromic Breakdown by Triage Category (BarChart).
key_components_to_build.data_flow_visualization: Interactive 5-stage pipeline diagram ('HOW HEALTHGRID WORKS'): Ingestion Telemetry -> AI Anomaly Engine -> Spatial Cluster -> Explainability Model -> Emergency Dispatch.
key_components_to_build.privacy_note: Footer/Sidebar banner detailing Differential Privacy (ε=0.5) and HIPAA/GDPR compliance.

data_testing_rules.naming_convention: kebab-case describing exact action or container

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Do NOT build a light, friendly medical website. This is a high-density, dark-mode CITY HEALTH COMMAND CENTER dashboard.
2. Ensure all interactive components include explicit data-testid attributes.
3. Enforce strict risk color rules: LOW = Emerald/Green (#10B981), MODERATE = Amber/Orange (#F59E0B), HIGH = Rose/Red (#EF4444).
4. Use Leaflet with Dark CartoDB basemap for the city map component and overlay interactive GeoJSON/polygon zones.
5. Provide multi-page sidebar navigation supporting all 6 routes specified in sidebar_routes.
6. Include the big 'SIMULATE INCOMING DATA' and 'RESET SIMULATION' buttons, with loading state 'Analyzing incoming signals...'.
7. Include Recharts analytics charts and Explainability 'WHY WAS ZONE 4 FLAGGED?' panel.
8. Make sure all overlays, popups, dropdowns, and sticky panels have non-transparent solid dark backgrounds with backdrop-blur.
